questions.question: What news distressed Nehemiah?
options: Jerusalem's wall was broken down and its gates burned
A famine had spread through the land of Judah
The temple of the LORD had been wholly torn to the ground
The king of Persia had ordered the work stopped
questions.answer: Jerusalem's wall was broken down and its gates burned
